package com.x;
public class BRes extends BWebServlet {
  void body(WebOp op) {
    try (Reader r = open()) {
      int a = Integer.parseInt(op.get("a"));
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) { op.getResponse().sendError(400); }
  }
  void resource(WebOp op) {
    try (Reader r = open(Integer.parseInt(op.get("b")))) {
      use(r);
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) { op.getResponse().sendError(400); }
  }
  void after(WebOp op) {
    try (Reader r = open()) { use(r); } catch (Exception e) { op.getResponse().sendError(400); }
    int c = Integer.parseInt(op.get("c"));
  }
}
